conclusion.relevance_to_dk_bond_tracker: NSDL is already our primary live source and matches the broker stack. Ratings come from agency rationales, not exchanges. BSE/NSE public feeds block non-members; brokers get member/access feeds we cannot scrape. Candidate future sources: NSDL remains primary; rating rationale pages (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/Acuite) as a new official-facts adapter.
